implementation_summary: Repaired self-report/reflection memory-source validation so nested metadata.source.kind, metadata.source.type, and related source fields are rejected before ingest persistence.
Separated backtest command-result experience metrics from unique PR metrics: experiences_agent_attributed now counts canonical experience records and agent_attributed_prs carries the PR count.
Extended recurrence report metrics with agent_attributed_experiences and kept schema, tests, README, and developer guide output-contract notes in sync.
Rebuilt report diagnostics and badge fields after --save-baseline replaces stale baseline comparison state.
Aggregated top repeated mistakes by matched recurrence signature while preserving the current record signature_id on recurrence pairs.
Rejected top-level object_type and event_type self-report/reflection markers before ingest persistence.
Kept newly emitted T8 recurrence-report fields optional for schema_version 1.0 while continuing to emit them from new reports.
Preferred canonical recurrence keys over raw generated signature IDs when aggregating top repeated mistakes across regenerated signatures.
Computed README badge staleness from explicit last_ingest_at metadata and merged-PR activity metadata, treating missing ingest or activity metadata as stale before badge publication.
Rejected top-level self-report and reflection markers on canonical distill --input experience records before memory-rule writes.
Rejected metadata-level object, event, type, kind, and nested source.object_type self-report/reflection markers before ingest persistence and canonical distill memory-rule writes.
Validated existing experience shard JSON objects for self-report/reflection markers before decoding into the canonical experienceRecord struct.
Stamped relia ingest runs with last_ingest_at and merged_prs_since_last_ingest metadata so freshly ingested historical records do not inherit stale badge status from old outcome windows.
Excluded volatile badge freshness metadata from source_artifact_digest calculation so baseline freshness reflects recurrence input drift rather than ingest timestamp churn.
Treated negative or invalid merged_prs_since_last_ingest metadata as unavailable activity freshness so corrupted shards produce stale badges instead of current badges with negative PR counts.
Rejected separatorless and camelCase self-report/reflection source markers such as agentSelfReport and selfReported before ingest persistence or memory-rule writes.
